Natural Heritage
Bolinao, Pangasinan

Cape Bolinao

A historic, towering navigational landmark situated on the rocky cliffs of Punta Piedra Point in Patar, Bolinao, Pangasinan.

Natural Heritage
Balungao, Pangasinan

Balungao Hot Spring

A mountain-volcano resort in Pangasinan, Philippines, featuring natural sulfuric hot and cold springs.

Natural Heritage
Burgos, Pangasinan

Cabongaoan Beach

This rocky side of the beach is home to the ever famous death pool. It offers an amazing experience on how calm and extreme the waves can get in a split second so you better be careful dipping here if you are not a swimmer.

ABOUT THE SHOWCASE

A digital window into Pangasinan.

This academic prototype demonstrates a resilient, accessible, maintainable, and high-performing heritage showcase using Vue and Nuxt 3.

The interface follows an Atomic Design component system so individual UI pieces can be reused across future tourism pages.
